title: Relays and line of sight
purpose: Teach why terrain and the Moon's curve block radio, why relays sit on high peaks, and how high one must be.

beats.label: model
beats.sub: The real terrain check needs the LOLA map; the game's relays are fiction

captions: Radio travels in straight lines, and the Moon's surface curves away.
Around {day} {year}, Earth is below the pole's horizon: no direct link.
A relay on a high peak can see both the base and Earth.
To see Earth then, it must stand at least {h} km high.
Repeaters along a road pass the signal hop by hop.
This is geometry, before the real terrain check.
ends_on: If you cannot see it, you cannot talk to it. Put a relay where both ends are in view.
